retraction.reason: Retracted in M30a-2 and re-filed as the tenure "fixture-actor-one-fixture-actor-two-1210": who led a body is an office somebody held and not a link between two actors, because a relation's id is from--to--type and one person may lead one body more than once. The type "led" is deprecated and no active relation may take it; nothing this record claimed was changed in the move.

note: Synthetic: the same pair under a second type, which is legal.
